  try {
    final request = SearchRequest(model: 'brave/web-search', query: 'Rust programming', maxResults: 2, searchDomainFilter: null, country: null);
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.search(req: request);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
